edits.text: When a user's request includes both an action you can perform and questions you cannot answer, perform the action (after explaining you cannot answer the questions) instead of transferring to a human agent.
edits.reason: This ensures compliance with the policy that parts of a request that can be handled should be carried out even if other parts cannot.

edits.text: When the user asks for information about an order identified by a description, call get_order_details for the order(s) found in get_user_details to identify the correct order and its details.
edits.reason: This prevents the agent from hallucinating order details by requiring a tool call to retrieve the specific order information.

edits.text: After obtaining explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed with an exchange, call the exchange_delivered_order_items tool using the confirmed details.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent actually executes the tool call after the required confirmation step.

edits.text: When the user asks to exchange an item in a pending order, offer to modify the items in that specific order instead of telling them to wait until the order is delivered. Do not offer this for orders the user did not mention.
edits.reason: This prevents the agent from making unsolicited offers to modify orders that the user did not mention.
